time_series_query.prometheus_query:
sum by (cluster) (custom_googleapis_com:node_cifs_ops{monitored_resource="k8s_cluster",datacenter=~"${Datacenter.value}",cluster=~"${Cluster.value}"})
and
topk(10, sum by (cluster) (avg_over_time(custom_googleapis_com:node_cifs_ops{monitored_resource="k8s_cluster",datacenter=~"${Datacenter.value}",cluster=~"${Cluster.value}"}[3h] @ end())))

sum by (cluster) (custom_googleapis_com:node_nfs_ops{monitored_resource="k8s_cluster",datacenter=~"${Datacenter.value}",cluster=~"${Cluster.value}"})

sum by (cluster) (custom_googleapis_com:volume_total_ops{monitored_resource="k8s_cluster",datacenter=~"${Datacenter.value}",cluster=~"${Cluster.value}"})

topk(10,sum by (cluster) (avg_over_time(custom_googleapis_com:volume_total_ops{monitored_resource="k8s_cluster",datacenter=~"${Datacenter.value}",cluster=~"${Cluster.value}"}[3h] @ end())))
